card.name: Section headings in beta-blocker warnings
card.fires_on: Marks at the start of a new warning heading or item in beta-blocker labels, such as the start of Hypoglycemia or Hypotension after a section number, or a colon or closing bracket before a new heading.

modes.label: Start of heading
modes.description: The first piece of a warning heading after a section number or a sentence end, such as Hyp in Hypoglycemia.

modes.label: Heading punctuation
modes.description: A colon or closing bracket just before the next warning topic.

card.plain: It lights up at the point where a beta-blocker label moves on to a new warning heading.
